desc: The new PX-9 Carry is here! Taking the best features of our full-size PX-9 Duty and offering it a compact size perfect for concealed or everyday carry with a capacity of up to 15rds of 9MM from P228 pattern magazines. A set of Glock pattern sights are standard that have a serrated rear and front sight that can be changed easily with many aftermarket options. Despite the small size of the PX-9 Carry, the grip is further enhanced with a subtle rubber over-molding on the interchangeable grip panels and back-straps allowing for best in class customization for superb ergonomics.
